channel.title: Hirani Law Firm Blog
channel.description: Practical legal guides from Hirani Law Firm on Texas divorce, child custody, property division, and car accident claims. Serving Houston, Katy, and Fort Bend County.

item.title: 12 Factors Texas Judges Consider in Child Custody Cases
item.description: Facing a custody hearing in Texas? Learn the 12 factors judges weigh, the difference between conservatorship and possession, and how to prepare. Free confidential consultation.
item.dc:creator: Sehar Hirani

item.title: Getting Divorced in Texas? Here's How Property and Debt Get Divided
item.description: Texas is a community property state — here's what that means for your assets, debts, and what might be protected in a divorce. Free consultation with a family law attorney.
item.dc:creator: Sehar Hirani

item.title: Injured in a Car Accident in Texas? Here's What to Do in the First 72 Hours
item.description: Been in a car accident in Texas? Learn the 4 critical steps to take in the first 72 hours to protect your health and your legal claim. Free consultation, no fees unless we win.
item.dc:creator: Sehar Hirani
